$comment: Command Governor pin record. This file is the single source of truth for
which Pi runtime the distribution targets; nothing else may hardcode a
version string. See docs/pi-distribution.md for the re-pin ritual.
Third-party Pi package policy: Pi keeps no lockfile for the packages it
installs, and its `pinned` flag is satisfied by any git ref -- including a
mutable tag or branch. A pin recorded here is therefore only meaningful if
it is immutable, so `packages[]` entries MUST carry either an exact npm
version (`exactVersion`, e.g. "0.62.0") or a 40-character git commit SHA
